fallback.reason: The block-family end (0x594280), the prompt fallback boundary (0x594280), and the B/C boundary (0x595000) are ALL mid-chunk-89 (the 64KB report chunk is 0x591000..0x5A1000). tools/assemble_original_mips.js requires every tracked manifest chunk to EXACTLY tile its 64KB source-report chunk (it throws if parts do not end exactly at the report-chunk end), and promote refuses partial overlaps — so a partial-interior chunk 89 (0x591000..0x595000) is NOT representable. Owning the WHOLE report chunk 89 (0x591000..0x5A1000) would require source-owning Section C bytes past 0x595000, which the prompt forbids ("Do not claim any Section C bytes past 0x00595000"). So 0x591000 (chunk 88 end) is the only pipeline-clean boundary <= 0x595000. This is a stop/fallback condition: "source-owner manifest/tooling cannot safely represent the planned split" + "the directory tail needs a separate pass".
